key.villagerverdict.probe.desc: Start or pause automatic trade reading for nearby villagers.

vv.clearWorldConfirm: Clear all saved villager records in %s? Your Wanted Trades and Regions will be kept.
vv.clearServerConfirm: Clear all saved villager records for %s? Your Wanted Trades and Regions will be kept.
vv.probeExplanation: Auto-read quietly inspects nearby unread villagers one by one using normal interactions. It never buys, sells, or touches your inventory, and swaps hands automatically if you hold a name tag or spawn egg. It only runs when you are idle, with no menu open and a clear line of sight. Enable for this world or server?
vv.confidence.HIGH: All current trades read; verdict is reliable
vv.confidence.MEDIUM: Trades read; replacement needs nearby confirmation
vv.confidence.LOW: Tip: Record may be outdated or higher levels remain locked
vv.complete.CURRENT: All available villager levels are unlocked
vv.complete.UNLOCKED_LEVELS_REMAIN: Higher levels can still unlock new trades
vv.reason.coverage: Meets your goals or offers the best known price
vv.reason.redundant: All known trades are already covered by kept villagers
vv.reason.review: Outdated scan, replacement far away, or missing coverage
vv.reason.uninspected: Trades have not been read yet
vv.reason.stale: Saved trades expired; move closer to re-read
vv.reason.gap: Some trades lack kept replacements (outside targets or manually ignored)
vv.reason.unavailable: Replacement villager is unloaded or their saved trades expired
vv.reason.unknown: Locked higher levels may reveal valuable trades later
